title: Facing El Chapo
plot: Two law-enforcement officers face the final hours of a dangerous shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss. As pressure mounts, they must survive an increasingly perilous situation while confronting the consequences of standing in the way of powerful criminal forces.

title: The Last Sunrise
plot: A college student with a chronic illness travels to Mallorca with her mother for the summer. After falling for a local, she starts embracing the present, but worsening health and family secrets threaten the life and connections she has discovered.

title: Obsession
plot: A hopeless romantic uses a mysterious wish-granting trinket to win his longtime crush’s heart. When the wish comes true, the relationship takes a sinister turn, trapping both of them in an increasingly unsettling nightmare where desire, control, and free will collide.

title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
plot: After a young superhero’s secret identity is exposed, his ordinary life becomes impossible to separate from his dangerous responsibilities. Seeking magical help to restore privacy, he triggers a crisis that brings powerful threats into his world and forces him to reconsider what being a hero truly demands.

title: Minions & Monsters
plot: A group of mischievous yellow stars rises from struggling filmmakers to Hollywood sensations, only to lose their success when movies change. After discovering an ancient spell and unleashing a monster, they must work together to stop the growing chaos and protect the world from their cinematic misadventure.

title: The Last House
plot: A family becomes trapped inside their home and must rely on one another as supplies run low. With an ominous threat keeping them confined, tensions rise and survival depends on cooperation, resilience, and difficult choices.

title: Disclosure Day
plot: A cybersecurity expert becomes a whistleblower after uncovering evidence of hidden alien secrets, forcing him to flee a powerful corporation. A meteorologist experiencing disturbing phenomena joins him, and together they race to reveal proof of life beyond human understanding while navigating a dangerous conspiracy.

title: Backrooms
plot: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.

title: The Whisper Man
plot: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.

title: Colony
plot: A scientist is caught in a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus spreads during a biotech conference, prompting authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with a small group of survivors, the scientist must fight to stay alive as the infected undergo horrific transformations.

title: War of the Worlds
plot: A government threat analyst monitors potential dangers through a mass surveillance system when an attack by an unknown entity disrupts everything. As the crisis unfolds, he begins questioning whether officials are concealing vital information from him and the public.

title: Project Hail Mary
plot: A science teacher wakes aboard a spaceship light-years from Earth with no memory of his identity or mission. As his memories return, he learns that a mysterious substance is threatening the Sun and must use his scientific knowledge, ingenuity, and unconventional ideas to help prevent a global catastrophe.

title: Supergirl
plot: A troubled superhero leaves Earth and wanders the galaxy, where she reluctantly joins a young warrior seeking revenge against a ruthless enemy. Their mission becomes even more urgent when the hero’s beloved dog is poisoned, sending the unlikely pair across the stars in search of justice and a cure.

title: Avengers: Infinity War
plot: The Avengers and their allies face a powerful intergalactic despot determined to gather six ancient artifacts and impose his will on all reality. As heroes from across the universe unite, their biggest challenge yet tests their strength, teamwork, and willingness to make difficult choices.

title: Masters of the Universe
plot: After 15 years apart, a powerful sword leads a young man back to Eternia, where he finds his home devastated by a ruthless tyrant. To protect his family and restore his world, he must join trusted allies, uncover his true potential, and become the hero Eternia needs.

title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba Infinity Castle
plot: A young demon hunter and his allies are pulled into a shifting fortress, where they confront powerful demons in a desperate struggle. As the conflict intensifies, the group faces terrifying battles and painful memories while the long-awaited final confrontation draws closer.

title: Greenland 2: Migration
plot: After surviving the comet’s devastation inside a Greenland bunker, a family leaves relative safety behind. They cross the ruined landscape of Europe, facing dangerous conditions and uncertain encounters as they search for a place where humanity might begin again.

title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
plot: Years after a legendary conflict, the world’s last airbender discovers an ancient power that could preserve his disappearing culture. Joined by friends, he travels across the globe to find it before dangerous forces claim it, threatening a fragile peace built through enormous sacrifice.

title: Avatar: Fire and Ash
plot: After a devastating war and a painful family loss, a former human soldier and his partner face a new danger on Pandora: a violent Na’vi tribe shaped by fire and hardship. As their family struggles to survive, the conflict tests their bonds, beliefs, and hopes for the planet’s future.

title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
plot: After joining a major superhero battle, a teenage hero tries to balance school, friendships, and everyday life with stopping crime in Queens. Eager to prove himself, he faces a dangerous new threat while learning that being a hero requires more than advanced technology and thrilling adventures.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
plot: A banker imprisoned for the murders of his wife and her lover begins a new life inside Shawshank prison. As he uses his accounting skills to navigate the institution, he forms a meaningful friendship with an older inmate and becomes admired for his integrity, resilience, and enduring hope.

title: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam
plot: When a bride refuses to leave her family home after marriage, her husband must find out if he can adjust to life under his in-laws' roof.

title: Michael
plot: A gifted young performer rises from a demanding family environment to become a globally celebrated entertainer. The story follows his early musical success, life away from the stage, creative ambitions, personal struggles, and landmark performances as he pursues an extraordinary career.

title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
plot: After reconnecting with a close friend, a Brooklyn teenager with spider-like abilities is pulled into a sprawling multiverse of heroes. When the protectors disagree over how to confront a dangerous new threat, he must challenge their rules and fight to protect the people he loves.

title: The Avengers
plot: When a powerful enemy threatens global security, an international peacekeeping agency assembles a team of extraordinary heroes. As these very different personalities struggle to work together, they must overcome their conflicts and unite to protect the world from disaster.

title: Desire
plot: A wealthy woman whose family life appears perfect becomes consumed by dissatisfaction after a young swimming coach enters her world. Their secret relationship fuels desire and jealousy, while tensions between a mother and daughter create a dangerous emotional triangle that threatens the stability she has built.

title: Zootopia 2
plot: After solving a major case, two rookie police partners follow a twisting mystery when a snake’s arrival unsettles the animal metropolis. Going undercover in unfamiliar parts of the city, they uncover hidden tensions while their partnership faces its toughest test yet.

title: Avengers: Endgame
plot: After a devastating defeat leaves the universe in ruins, the remaining heroes struggle with loss and uncertainty. As they reunite for one final mission to restore what was taken, they face enormous risks, difficult choices, and the consequences of trying to set things right.

title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
plot: After stopping a previous attempt to force a royal marriage, two adventurous brothers face a new threat from a determined young heir seeking to free his imprisoned father and restore their family legacy. Joined by familiar and new companions, they journey across the stars to stop the crusade.

title: Interstellar
plot: As Earth’s food supply collapses, a former pilot joins a group of explorers searching for a new home beyond a newly discovered wormhole. Their mission combines perilous space travel, complex cosmic phenomena, and a deeply personal struggle to protect humanity’s future while separated from family.

title: Spider-Man
plot: After a genetically altered spider bite gives a shy high school student extraordinary abilities, he begins discovering what it means to become a hero. As he navigates newfound powers, personal responsibility, and danger threatening his city, he faces a formidable enemy while trying to protect the people he cares about.

title: Raakaasa
plot: After a decade away, a returning expatriate comes home seeking romance and unknowingly awakens an ancient darkness feared by the village. As danger grows, love takes a deadly turn, forcing him to confront a threat that puts lives at risk.

title: The Furious
plot: When a criminal network kidnaps a father’s daughter and corrupt police refuse to help, he begins a desperate search on his own. A determined journalist, whose wife has also vanished, joins him, and together they fight through a dangerous underworld driven by grief, anger, and the need to bring their loved ones home.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
plot: In a harsh post-apocalyptic wasteland, a solitary survivor joins forces with a determined rebel and a group of women fleeing a tyrannical ruler. Pursued across the desert by violent gangs, they fight to survive while searching for a safer future.

title: The Dark Knight
plot: Batman joins forces with a police lieutenant and a determined public official to dismantle Gotham’s criminal organizations. Their progress is threatened when a rising criminal mastermind unleashes a campaign of chaos, forcing Batman to confront difficult choices about justice, fear, and the limits of heroism.

title: Shelter
plot: A man living alone on a remote island rescues a young girl during a violent storm. When the rescue exposes his hidden past, he must leave his secluded life and protect her from dangerous forces closing in.

title: The Godfather
plot: A powerful crime family faces growing threats as its aging patriarch barely survives an attack. His youngest son, initially distant from the family business, becomes involved in protecting his loved ones and is drawn into a violent struggle for control.

title: The Sheep Detectives
plot: A shepherd reads detective novels to his sheep each night, never suspecting they understand every word. When a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the flock follows clues, studies human suspects, and uses its unusual perspective to investigate what happened.

title: Spider-Man: Far from Home
plot: A teenager and his classmates head to Europe for a summer trip, but their plans change when a senior agent asks him to investigate mysterious creatures linked to natural disasters across the continent. As the danger grows, he must balance superhero responsibilities with school, friendship, and first love.

title: Inception
plot: A skilled thief who infiltrates dreams to steal secrets is offered a chance to return to his former life by completing an almost impossible job: planting an idea in someone’s subconscious. To succeed, he assembles a team and navigates increasingly complex layers of dreams.

title: The Devil's Mouth
plot: A group of college friends on an adventure in Thailand becomes trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As oxygen runs low, tensions and past conflicts intensify, forcing them to work together in a desperate fight to survive.

title: Hoppers
plot: A determined animal lover discovers technology that can place human consciousness into lifelike robotic animals. Using it to understand wildlife from the inside, she becomes involved in a struggle to protect a threatened natural habitat from an expanding road project.

title: Mortal Kombat II
plot: A group of battle-hardened champions, joined by a reluctant movie star, must confront a ruthless conqueror whose rule threatens Earthrealm and its defenders. Their dangerous mission leads to a brutal fantasy showdown filled with rivalries, powerful fighters, and no-holds-barred combat.

title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
plot: When an attempt to create a peacekeeping program goes wrong, a team of powerful heroes faces a dangerous artificial intelligence determined to threaten the planet. As the crisis grows, the heroes must overcome tensions, form uneasy alliances, and confront a global challenge together.

title: The Amazing Spider-Man
plot: A lonely high-school student investigating his family’s past is transformed by a mysterious spider bite. As he learns to control his new abilities, he balances romance, personal loss, and the growing threat posed by a scientist’s dangerous experiment.

title: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
plot: After a young girl vanishes into the desert, her devastated family spends years living with the loss. When she unexpectedly returns, their hoped-for reunion becomes a terrifying struggle as unsettling signs suggest she may not be the same child who disappeared.

title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
plot: In a vibrant retro-futuristic world, a super-powered family balances public heroism with the demands of an expanding family. When a mysterious herald warns that a ravenous space god threatens Earth, the team must confront an impossible choice while searching for a way to protect both their loved ones and humanity.

title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
plot: A Brooklyn teenager struggling with school, family, and his place in the world is bitten by a radioactive spider and gains extraordinary powers. When a dangerous experiment disrupts reality, spider-powered heroes from other dimensions arrive, forcing him to confront his fears and discover what it truly means to become a hero.

title: Freakier Friday
plot: Years after a mother and daughter’s first identity crisis, a new generation faces the challenges of blending two families. When multiple family members become caught up in another body-swapping adventure, they must navigate unfamiliar lives while trying to restore order and strengthen their relationships.

title: The Matrix
plot: In a dystopian future, a computer hacker discovers that everyday reality may be an elaborate digital illusion controlled by powerful machines. After joining underground rebels, he must learn the rules of this hidden world and decide how far he is willing to go to help free humanity.

title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
plot: An orphaned boy living with unkind relatives discovers on his eleventh birthday that he is a powerful wizard. Sent to a magical boarding school, he makes close friends, learns to control his abilities, and begins investigating the mystery surrounding his parents and a dangerous figure from the past.

title: The Debt Collector
plot: Haunted by past mistakes and facing a terminal diagnosis, a former debt collector returns to the criminal underworld. There, he takes on a violent organization while trying to protect the people caught in its path.

title: Predator: Badlands
plot: Cast out by his clan, a young Predator travels to a deadly planet to face a seemingly unbeatable creature. Along the way, he reluctantly teams up with a damaged android and a native creature, confronting dangerous wildlife, family expectations, and the limits of surviving alone.

title: Insidious: The Red Door
plot: A father and his college-aged son try to repair their strained relationship while disturbing memories and supernatural visions return. As they confront a sinister red door and the dangers beyond it, both must face their family's troubled past and the forces connected to it.

title: Oppenheimer
plot: During World War II, a brilliant physicist leads a secret team of scientists in developing the atomic bomb. As the project transforms global history, he faces the personal, political, and moral consequences of helping create a weapon whose power may be impossible to control.

title: Swapped
plot: A small woodland creature and a majestic bird, natural enemies in their valley, magically swap places and begin an adventure to return to normal. Along the way, they discover a serious threat that could endanger their species and the entire valley they call home.

title: Jurassic World: Rebirth
plot: Five years after the previous adventure, a covert team travels to an isolated island to collect genetic material from three enormous dinosaurs. Their mission becomes more dangerous when they encounter a stranded family and uncover a disturbing secret hidden there for decades.

title: The Wrecking Crew
plot: After their estranged father dies under mysterious circumstances, two half-brothers reunite in Hawaii to seek answers. A hot-headed detective and a disciplined military man must put aside their differences as their investigation uncovers buried family secrets and a conspiracy that threatens their loved ones and local communities.

title: Captain America: Civil War
plot: After devastating battles raise questions about accountability, governments seek authority over superhuman missions. The proposal divides the Avengers, with one faction supporting official oversight and another defending independence, while a fugitive linked to a founding hero’s past intensifies the conflict between former allies.

title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
plot: A young superhero balances protecting the city with his complicated relationship and the promise to keep his distance. His life becomes more difficult when a powerful new villain appears, an old friend returns, and clues about his family raise fresh questions about the past.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
plot: As armies gather for a decisive war, a reluctant heir must unite the forces of good while a brave hobbit and his loyal companion undertake a perilous journey into the enemy’s land. Their mission offers the only hope of destroying a powerful ring and saving their world.

title: Spider-Man 3
plot: A celebrated superhero faces several dangerous threats, including a shape-shifting criminal and a rival who becomes linked to a powerful alien organism. As the hero’s abilities and behavior change, he must also navigate strained friendships, romantic complications, and difficult choices about revenge and forgiveness.

title: Avatar: The Way of Water
plot: More than a decade after the earlier conflict, a family living on Pandora faces renewed danger and leaves its forest home in search of safety. Among a reef-dwelling community, they must adapt to unfamiliar customs and environments while protecting one another from threats that follow them.

title: In the Grey
plot: A covert team of elite operatives emerges from the shadows to recover a billion-dollar fortune stolen by a ruthless despot. Their seemingly impossible heist becomes a deadly contest of strategy, deception, and survival, demanding meticulous preparation before the operation erupts into relentless action.

title: The Wild Robot
plot: After a shipwreck, an intelligent robot is stranded on an uninhabited island. As the robot learns to survive among wary animals, it forms an unexpected bond with an orphaned baby goose and discovers new responsibilities, challenges, and connections in the natural world.

title: Coco
plot: Despite his family’s ban on music, a young boy dreams of becoming a musician. A mysterious chain of events transports him to the colorful Land of the Dead, where he teams up with a charming trickster to uncover the truth about his family’s history and find his way home.

title: Parasite
plot: An unemployed family sees a chance to improve their lives by entering the household of a wealthy family through a series of carefully arranged jobs. Their scheme initially brings opportunity and comedy, but growing complications place both families in an increasingly tense situation.

title: Thunderbolts*
plot: After being trapped in a deadly situation, a group of troubled outcasts must work together on a dangerous mission. As tensions rise, they confront painful memories, personal struggles, and the difficult question of whether they can become something more than their pasts.

title: The Dark Knight Rises
plot: Years after a disgraced masked vigilante disappears, a powerful terrorist leader and a mysterious cat burglar threaten a city struggling to preserve its fragile peace. Forced back into action, the wounded hero must confront his limits, rally unexpected allies, and protect the people who once turned against him.

title: Iron Man
plot: After being captured in Afghanistan, a billionaire weapons engineer is forced to build a powerful device for his captors. The experience changes his perspective, leading him to create a high-tech suit of armor and use his abilities to confront dangerous forces.

title: Insidious: Chapter 3
plot: Before the Lambert family haunting, a retired psychic reluctantly agrees to help a teenage girl who hopes to contact her dead mother. When a dangerous supernatural entity targets the girl, the psychic must confront her own fears and return to the spirit world.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
plot: A young hobbit inherits a mysterious ring and must leave his peaceful home to keep it from a powerful evil force. Joined by a diverse fellowship of companions, he begins a perilous journey across Middle-earth toward the only place where the ring can be destroyed.

title: Insidious: The Last Key
plot: A paranormal investigator and her team travel to a small New Mexico town to examine a reported haunting. The case becomes deeply personal when she discovers that the home at its center was once her family’s house, forcing her to confront a frightening chapter from her past.

title: A Child of My Own
plot: Desperate for a baby and pressured by family and society, a woman pretends to be pregnant. Her deception draws her into a dangerous crime, forcing her to navigate mounting pressure, difficult choices, and the consequences of trying to fulfill expectations that may not be her own.

title: War Machine
plot: During his final mission in Army Ranger training, a combat engineer takes charge of a struggling unit as they face a giant otherworldly killing machine. Forced to rely on endurance, quick thinking, and teamwork, he leads the group through a brutal fight for survival.

title: Top Gun: Maverick
plot: After decades as a celebrated Navy pilot, a veteran instructor is called back to train a new group of elite aviators for an exceptionally dangerous mission. As the team prepares, he must confront his past while earning the trust of pilots whose lives depend on his guidance.

title: Superman
plot: A journalist in Metropolis balances his life as a powerful alien hero with the human upbringing that shaped his values. As he faces a world marked by political tension, public distrust, and powerful opponents, he must decide how to remain hopeful while protecting the people around him.

title: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
plot: A veteran operative and his team race to stop a terrifying artificial intelligence that has infiltrated intelligence networks worldwide. Hunted by governments and a mysterious figure from the past, they seek the means to shut it down before it changes the world forever.

title: Toy Story
plot: A beloved cowboy toy faces an unexpected challenge when a flashy space-themed newcomer becomes the favorite in a child’s room. After rivalry separates them from their owner, the two must work together through a lively adventure, learning about friendship, loyalty, and accepting change.

title: Pulp Fiction
plot: Several criminals, a gangster’s restless companion, and a boxer whose career is fading become connected through a series of dangerous, darkly comic episodes. Told in a playful, out-of-order structure, the film follows their tense encounters, unexpected complications, and sharply observed conversations across Los Angeles.

title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
plot: A reprogrammed cyborg travels back in time to protect a young boy from an advanced shape-shifting machine sent to kill him. Joined by the boy’s determined mother, they race to prevent a future nuclear catastrophe while confronting questions about fate, humanity, and whether the future can be changed.

title: The Housemaid
plot: Trying to rebuild her life, a woman accepts a live-in housemaid position with a wealthy family. The dream opportunity soon becomes a tense maze of suspicion, attraction, and hidden power, as troubling behavior inside the seemingly perfect home makes her question whom she can trust.

title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
plot: A sorcerer and his mystical allies travel through dangerous alternate realities after a young woman with extraordinary powers becomes a target. As the boundaries between universes grow more unstable, they face a mysterious adversary and confront the risks of unleashing the multiverse.

title: Venom: The Last Dance
plot: A fugitive and his alien symbiote partner are pursued by human forces and deadly creatures from another world. As their enemies close in and a powerful threat endangers more than their own survival, the pair must confront difficult choices while trying to stay together.

title: The Wolf of Wall Street
plot: A New York stockbroker builds a fortune through securities fraud, lavish spending, and reckless ambition while federal investigators close in. Based on an autobiography, the film follows his rise through a world of corruption, excess, and increasingly dangerous choices.

title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
plot: Harry, Ron and Hermione race to destroy the remaining magical objects sustaining Voldemort’s power while the wizarding world faces its greatest threat. Their search leads them back to Hogwarts, where friends and defenders prepare for a dangerous confrontation that will test their courage, loyalty and determination.

title: GOAT
plot: A small goat with big dreams gets a rare chance to join the professional roarball league, a fast, full-contact sport dominated by larger, tougher animals. Facing skepticism from his new teammates and the pressure of competing at the highest level, he must prove that determination and teamwork can matter more than size.

title: Troy
plot: A Trojan prince’s romance with a Spartan queen sparks a devastating conflict between two powerful kingdoms. As a vast Greek army sails toward Troy, warriors, rulers, and families are drawn into a brutal struggle shaped by love, ambition, pride, and the pursuit of lasting glory.

title: The Incredible Hulk
plot: A scientist on the run searches for a cure to the uncontrollable force of rage inside him. When military forces pursue him and seek to exploit his abilities, he returns to civilization and faces a dangerous new opponent.

title: Insidious: Chapter 2
plot: After a disturbing encounter leaves the Lambert family facing continued supernatural danger, they search for answers about a childhood connection to the spirit world. As unsettling events spread between the past and present, the family and their allies work to understand the forces threatening them.

title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
plot: During a young wizard’s second year at a magical school, a house-elf delivers a troubling warning before mysterious attacks spread through the halls. With students in danger and an ancient secret threatening the school, the young wizard and two close friends must follow clues, face frightening creatures, and rely on courage and magic.

title: Titanic
plot: Decades after the Titanic’s voyage, an elderly woman recalls boarding the ship as a young woman with her mother and fiancé. Her life changes when she meets a free-spirited passenger from a very different social class, as romance unfolds against the looming danger surrounding the ship’s first and final voyage.

title: Schindler's List
plot: During World War II, a wealthy businessman opens a factory in occupied Poland, initially seeking profit through wartime connections. As persecution intensifies, he gradually risks his fortune and safety to protect Jewish workers from Nazi brutality and deportation.

title: Fight Club
plot: An insomniac office worker meets a charismatic soap salesman who offers a radical escape from consumer culture. Together, they create an underground fighting group that spreads rapidly, drawing in frustrated men and pushing their rebellion toward increasingly dangerous consequences.

title: The Terminator
plot: In a bleak future ruled by machines, a nearly unstoppable cyborg is sent back to 1984 to hunt a young woman whose unborn child could change humanity’s fate. A battle-scarred soldier follows from the future to protect her, forcing them into a desperate fight for survival.

title: Thor: Love and Thunder
plot: A retired thunder god is drawn back into action when a cosmic killer targets the gods. Joined by a powerful former partner, a warrior king, and a rock-like ally, he races across the universe to rescue captured children, confront the threat, and rediscover his purpose.

title: Dune: Part Two
plot: A young nobleman joins the desert-dwelling Fremen on Arrakis, seeking revenge against those who destroyed his family. As he grows closer to a fierce warrior and becomes a possible leader, he must weigh personal love against a dangerous vision of the future.

title: KPop Demon Hunters
plot: Three K-pop superstars fill stadiums by day and secretly protect their fans from supernatural threats. Balancing demanding pop careers with dangerous battles, the performers must work together as a team while facing challenges that test their courage, friendship, and sense of self.

title: The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies
plot: After a dragon attacks a lakeside town, a hobbit and a company of dwarves defend a mountain of treasure claimed by rival men and elves. As a vast orc army approaches, old disputes must give way to an uneasy alliance in a battle that could determine the fate of the wider world.

title: Avatar
plot: In the 22nd century, a paraplegic Marine travels to Pandora for a mission involving an alien civilization. As he explores the moon and grows closer to its inhabitants, he faces a difficult choice between obeying orders and protecting their home.

title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1
plot: After the death of a beloved mentor, three young wizards leave school behind to find and destroy magical objects tied to an immortal dark lord. Hunted by his followers and forced into hiding, they face danger, isolation, and growing pressure as their friendship is tested.

title: The Green Mile
plot: On death row in a Southern prison, a compassionate guard encounters a gentle giant with a mysterious gift for healing. As the guard learns more about the condemned man, he faces difficult questions about justice, mercy, and whether the execution can be prevented.

title: Gladiator
plot: After a revered ruler dies, his ambitious son seizes power and strips a loyal general of his rank. Forced into slavery and trained as a gladiator, the once-respected soldier must survive brutal arena battles while confronting a corrupt empire and fighting to reclaim his honor.

title: Forrest Gump
plot: A kind-hearted Alabama man with below-average intelligence moves through childhood, military service, fame, and unexpected success while remaining remarkably sincere. As he encounters major moments in American history, he stays focused on loyalty, friendship, and his enduring feelings for a childhood companion.

title: The Drama
plot: A happily engaged couple sees their wedding week unravel after an unexpected confession shakes their relationship and unsettles their closest friends. As the fallout grows, they confront difficult questions about trust, judgment, forgiveness, and whether love can survive an uncomfortable truth.

title: Dune: Part One
plot: A gifted young heir leaves his home with his family for Arrakis, a dangerous desert world that holds the empire’s most valuable resource. As rival forces move against them, he must confront fear, political conflict, and troubling visions of a destiny he does not yet understand.

title: F1: The Movie
plot: A retired racing legend is drawn back into Formula 1 to help rescue a struggling team and mentor its promising young driver. As they face fierce competition, team pressures, and the demands of life at high speed, the veteran must decide how far he is willing to go for another shot at glory.

title: Whiplash
plot: A gifted young drummer at an elite music school pursues greatness under a terrifying instructor who demands perfection. As the pressure intensifies, the drummer must decide how much of his health, relationships, and humanity he is willing to sacrifice for success.

title: The Conjuring
plot: A family moves into a remote farmhouse and soon faces frightening supernatural disturbances. When paranormal investigators arrive to help, they uncover a deeply troubling presence and must work to protect the family from an escalating threat.

title: Big Hero 6
plot: A gifted teenager and an inflatable healthcare robot form a close bond after a devastating loss. Joined by a group of inventive friends, they use their talents and upgraded technology to become high-tech heroes while investigating a mysterious threat in their futuristic city.

title: My Fault
plot: A proud, independent teenager leaves her old life behind to move into her mother’s wealthy new husband’s mansion. There, she meets her new stepbrother, and their opposing personalities quickly create tension, attraction, and complicated family dynamics.

title: The Godfather Part II
plot: A young immigrant builds a new life in New York after fleeing Sicily, gradually establishing influence in the city’s criminal underworld. Decades later, his son expands the family business across Las Vegas, Hollywood, and Cuba while struggling to maintain control and protect his family.

title: A Minecraft Movie
plot: Four misfits are pulled through a mysterious portal into the Overworld, a colorful cubic world shaped by imagination. To return home, they must learn its rules, survive its dangers, and join an unexpected expert crafter on a magical quest.

title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
plot: A young wizard returns to Hogwarts for a dangerous school year after a notorious prisoner escapes from a feared wizarding prison. As mysterious creatures and troubling threats surround the castle, he and his friends uncover secrets connected to the past while facing growing danger.

title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
plot: A young wizard is unexpectedly chosen to compete in a dangerous contest between three magical schools, despite being underage. As he faces a series of demanding challenges with help from his friends, troubling signs point toward the return of a powerful dark force.

title: The Lion King
plot: A young lion prince dreams of becoming king while growing up under his father’s guidance. When his uncle schemes for the throne, the cub faces betrayal, loss, and exile before beginning a journey toward responsibility and his rightful place.

title: Ice Age: Collision Course
plot: An acorn-obsessed rodent accidentally triggers cosmic events that send a dangerous threat toward Earth. As the planet faces upheaval, a mismatched herd leaves home and travels through strange new places, searching for a way to protect their families and survive the adventure.

title: The Super Mario Bros. Movie
plot: Two Brooklyn plumbers are swept through a mysterious pipe into a magical world. Separated from his brother, one of them sets out across colorful kingdoms, meeting unlikely allies and facing dangerous obstacles in a quest to reunite their family.

title: Joker
plot: In 1980s Gotham City, a struggling comedian faces isolation, hardship, and growing hostility from the world around him. As his efforts to connect and find purpose repeatedly fail, he begins a disturbing transformation that draws him toward crime, violence, and a darker public identity.

title: Ready or Not 2: Here I Come
plot: After surviving a deadly family game, a hardened woman is pulled into an even larger night of violence with her estranged sister. Together, they must evade hunters from four powerful rival families while facing a brutal contest whose prize is control of a secretive global council.

title: Fast X
plot: A seasoned driver and his close-knit crew face a dangerous adversary driven by revenge from the past. As the threat targets everything they value, the team is pulled into a globe-spanning race involving explosive attacks, high-speed chases, daring fights, and increasingly impossible odds.

title: Shrek
plot: A reclusive ogre’s peaceful swamp is overrun by banished fairy-tale creatures. To reclaim his home, he sets out with a talkative donkey on a quest to rescue a princess from a dragon-guarded castle, encountering comic adventures and unexpected lessons along the way.

title: One Battle After Another
plot: A washed-up former revolutionary lives off-grid with his spirited teenage daughter, trying to escape the consequences of his past. When a dangerous enemy resurfaces and the girl goes missing, he sets out to find her, drawing on old allies while father and daughter face a turbulent world shaped by political conflict.

title: The Batman
plot: In his second year as a crime-fighter, a brooding vigilante investigates a series of murders in Gotham City. Working with a police ally and a mysterious thief, he uncovers corruption reaching into the city’s powerful circles and is forced to reconsider what his mission truly means.

title: Chainsaw Man - The Movie: Reze Arc
plot: A young devil hunter’s routine changes when a mysterious girl enters his life, drawing him into a dangerous mix of romance, deception, and brutal battles. As devils, hunters, and hidden enemies collide, he must decide whom to trust while fighting to survive.

title: Inside Out 2
plot: A teenager’s mind is disrupted by puberty as new emotions arrive and challenge the established team. While preparing for an important hockey camp and trying to fit in with new peers, she faces social pressure, changing friendships, and an increasingly complicated sense of who she wants to be.

title: WALL·E
plot: On a deserted Earth buried under waste, a solitary cleanup robot discovers a new sense of purpose after meeting an advanced probe. Their connection leads them from the planet to a vast spacecraft, where their journey could affect humanity’s future.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
plot: A divided fellowship follows separate paths as a ring-bearer and his companion journey toward a deadly land, while three allies search for captured friends and help defend a threatened kingdom. Meanwhile, a corrupt wizard gathers a vast army, pushing the realm toward a decisive battle.

title: The Devil Wears Prada
plot: A young Midwestern woman moves to New York hoping to become a writer, but instead lands an assistant job at a major fashion magazine. Working for a demanding, intimidating editor, she enters a glamorous, high-pressure world that challenges her priorities, relationships, and sense of self.

title: Spirited Away
plot: A young girl is pulled into a mysterious spirit world after her parents undergo a strange transformation. To save her family and find a way home, she must find work, navigate an unfamiliar bathhouse, and discover courage, trust, and compassion.

title: Seven
plot: Two homicide detectives investigate a series of gruesome murders modeled on the seven deadly sins. A seasoned investigator studies the killer’s pattern while his impatient rookie partner pushes forward, forcing them to confront a case that grows darker and more disturbing with every clue.

title: Monsters, Inc.
plot: In a monster city powered by children's screams, a top scarer and his wisecracking partner face chaos when a little girl enters their world. As they try to keep her hidden and return her home, their assumptions about children—and their own workplace—are challenged.

title: Don't Say Good Luck
plot: A determined high school student is ready to step into the spotlight as the lead in a school musical. But just as rehearsals and performances demand her attention, unexpected drama at home makes life more complicated than anything happening onstage.

title: Apex
plot: Grieving and determined to test herself, a woman ventures alone into the Australian wilderness, where a hostile landscape becomes even more dangerous when she is drawn into a deadly pursuit with a calculating killer who sees her as prey.

title: Sinners
plot: Twin brothers return to their hometown hoping to start over by opening a new gathering place, but their plans are threatened when a powerful evil arrives. As the night unfolds, the brothers and their community must confront danger, temptation, and forces tied to the music that brings them together.

title: How to Train Your Dragon
plot: On a rugged island where Vikings and dragons have fought for generations, a young Viking outsider secretly befriends a feared dragon. Their growing bond challenges long-held beliefs and forces the community to reconsider its relationship with the creatures it fears.

title: The Brutalist
plot: After fleeing post-war Europe, an ambitious architect arrives in Pennsylvania hoping to rebuild his career and reunite with his wife. A wealthy patron offers him a major project, but the opportunity brings difficult power dynamics, personal strain, and a challenging path toward belonging in modern America.

title: Deadpool
plot: After a mercenary undergoes a rogue experiment that leaves him with accelerated healing and a disfigured appearance, he adopts a wisecracking masked identity. Driven by love and revenge, he sets out to confront the man responsible, using brutal skills and an irreverent sense of humor.

title: Thor: The Dark World
plot: A powerful warrior must defend the cosmos when an ancient enemy seeks to plunge the universe into darkness. As the threat reaches both a fantastical realm and Earth, he faces a dangerous mission involving old allies, family tensions, and difficult sacrifices.

title: Moana 2
plot: After an unexpected message from her ancestors, a young wayfinder sets out across Oceania with a legendary demigod and a new crew. Together, they face dangerous waters, ancient mysteries, and a mission that could reconnect scattered communities while testing their teamwork and courage.

title: Fifty Shades of Grey
plot: A college senior interviews a wealthy, enigmatic businessman after filling in for her sick roommate. Their attraction grows into an intense affair, but his unconventional desires challenge her boundaries and force them to confront what each wants from the relationship.

title: Fury
plot: In April 1945, a battle-hardened army sergeant leads a five-person Sherman tank crew on a dangerous mission behind enemy lines. As the Allies make their final push, a rookie soldier joins the crew and faces the brutal realities of combat and survival.

title: Blade Runner 2049
plot: Decades after the original events, a new blade runner uncovers a long-buried secret that could plunge a fragile society into chaos. His investigation sends him searching for a former blade runner who has been missing for thirty years, while forcing him to question identity, memory, and what it means to be human.

title: Toy Story 3
plot: As their longtime owner prepares to leave for college, a beloved group of toys faces an uncertain future after being mistakenly sent to a daycare center. What first seems like a fresh start becomes a dangerous situation, forcing them to work together on an escape and confront the challenge of moving on.

title: Thor
plot: An arrogant warrior god is cast down to Earth after recklessly reigniting an ancient war against his father’s wishes. Living among humans, he must learn humility and what true heroism means when dangerous forces from his home realm threaten the planet.

title: Iron Man 2
plot: With his identity as an armored superhero now public, a billionaire inventor faces pressure from the government, the media, and rivals seeking his technology. As his health and legacy complicate his choices, he must rely on trusted allies while confronting a dangerous new threat and expanding the reach of his armored suits.

title: Inglourious Basterds
plot: In Nazi-occupied France during World War II, a squad of Jewish-American soldiers wages a brutal campaign against Nazi forces. Their path intersects with a young French-Jewish woman who runs a Paris cinema and becomes involved in a dangerous plan targeting prominent Nazi figures.

title: Finding Nemo
plot: A curious young fish is taken from his ocean home to an aquarium, leaving his anxious father determined to find him. Along the way, the father is joined by a friendly, forgetful companion, while the young fish works with his new tank mates to seek a way back to the sea.

title: Kraven the Hunter
plot: A young man’s difficult relationship with his ruthless gangster father sends him on a path of vengeance. After a transformative encounter in the wilderness, he develops extraordinary abilities and dedicates himself to becoming the world’s greatest hunter while facing dangerous criminals and brutal consequences.

title: Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope
plot: When a princess is captured by an oppressive galactic regime, a restless farm boy joins forces with a charming captain and two quirky droids. Guided by an old guardian, they embark on a daring rescue mission that could help restore freedom and justice across the galaxy.

title: Revenge
plot: After his wife is brutally murdered, a decorated special forces veteran becomes consumed by revenge. When an unexpected turn of fortune makes him wealthy, he uses his money to build an arsenal and joins his closest soldiers in pursuing those responsible.

title: John Wick: Chapter 4
plot: With a bounty on his head, a legendary assassin searches for a way to escape a powerful criminal organization. His journey takes him across the globe, where he confronts a dangerous new adversary, relies on old connections, and battles overwhelming forces in pursuit of freedom.

title: Black Adam
plot: After nearly 5,000 years imprisoned in an ancient tomb, a powerful figure is freed and returns to a modern world under oppression. As he delivers his ruthless version of justice, a group of heroes arrives to challenge his methods and determine whether he is a savior or a threat.

title: Now You See Me: Now You Don't
plot: A veteran team of illusionists reunites with three younger performers to target a powerful diamond heiress whose criminal empire is built on money laundering and trafficking. To steal a valuable diamond from a heavily protected location, the divided magicians must overcome their differences and attempt their most ambitious heist yet.

title: Zootopia
plot: A determined young rabbit becomes the first of her kind to join a city police force, but proving herself is harder than expected. When mammals begin disappearing, she reluctantly teams up with a clever fox to investigate the case and uncover tensions threatening the city’s peaceful society.

title: Hacksaw Ridge
plot: During World War II, a devout American medic joins the Army but refuses to carry or use a weapon. Facing hostility during training and the terrifying realities of battle, he remains committed to saving wounded soldiers while serving at Okinawa’s Hacksaw Ridge.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy: Vol. 2
plot: A spacefaring team struggles to stay united while confronting threats, old wounds, and questions surrounding one member’s mysterious parentage. Along the way, each member faces personal challenges that test their trust, loyalty, and idea of family.

title: Frozen
plot: A young princess sets out to end an eternal winter that has overtaken her kingdom. Joined by an ice seller, a reindeer, and a cheerful snowman, she faces a dangerous journey while discovering the meaning of family, friendship, courage, and true love.

title: Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom
plot: A powerful enemy returns seeking revenge and threatens Atlantis with an ancient weapon. To defend the underwater kingdom, Arthur must form an uneasy alliance with his imprisoned brother, forcing former rivals to work together against a growing danger.

title: Your Name.
plot: Two high school students living in different parts of Japan unexpectedly begin switching bodies. As the strange exchanges continue, they adapt to one another’s routines and leave messages to stay connected, gradually forming an unusual bond while trying to understand what is happening.

title: Up
plot: A widowed older man fulfills a lifelong dream by lifting his home with balloons and traveling toward a distant South American destination. A young wilderness scout accidentally joins him, and together they encounter unusual wildlife, talking dogs, and unexpected challenges along the way.

title: Home Alone 2: Lost in New York
plot: A young boy accidentally travels to New York without his family and settles into a luxurious hotel using a parent’s credit card. While exploring the city, he encounters two familiar burglars planning a holiday robbery and uses his cleverness, courage, and elaborate traps to stop them.

title: Beast Race
plot: In a dystopian future inspired by Brazil’s illegal animal lottery, a fearless young man enters a deadly race to save his sister. Each animal in the game is represented by a runner competing for a coveted prize.

title: Miniforce - New Heroes Rise
plot: Four animal superheroes called the Miniforce transform into robots to protect small and defenseless creatures from the hands of scheming villains.

title: Wuthering Heights
plot: In 18th-century England, tragedy unfolds when a passionate young man falls in love with a woman from a wealthy family. Their forbidden relationship is tested by social expectations, ambition, and the demands of a world determined to keep them apart.

title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
plot: After the death of Wakanda’s king, the nation’s leaders and defenders struggle to protect their home from foreign pressure and a powerful underwater civilization. As grief, responsibility, and competing claims threaten to divide them, a young inventor and her allies must help shape Wakanda’s uncertain future.

title: Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die
plot: A mysterious visitor claiming to come from the future arrives at a Los Angeles diner and recruits a carefully chosen group of unhappy patrons. Together, they embark on a dangerous overnight mission to prevent a rogue artificial intelligence from threatening the world, while police close in and the recruits’ troubled pasts emerge.

title: Meg 2: The Trench
plot: A daring research team ventures into the deepest ocean trench, where their mission is disrupted by a dangerous mining operation. Facing betrayal, giant prehistoric sharks, and other creatures from the depths, the survivors must fight their way through a chaotic struggle for survival.

title: Jurassic World: Dominion
plot: Four years after a dinosaur sanctuary is destroyed, prehistoric creatures roam freely across the globe, forcing humans to adapt to a dangerous new reality. When a young woman and a baby dinosaur are taken, two groups of unlikely allies pursue separate leads that eventually draw them toward a powerful genetics company and a remote mountain facility.

title: The Maze Runner
plot: A teenager with no memory awakens in a walled enclosure where a group of boys has built a fragile society beside a vast, shifting maze. As he learns their rules, dangerous expeditions and new clues push him to challenge the group’s routines and search for a way out.

title: Star Wars: Episode VIII - The Last Jedi
plot: A young woman works to deepen her newly discovered abilities under the guidance of a reluctant former Jedi. Elsewhere, the dwindling Resistance faces relentless pursuit from the First Order, forcing its leaders and fighters to make difficult choices as they struggle to survive.

title: Deadpool 2
plot: A wisecracking mercenary tries to protect a troubled young mutant from a powerful soldier from the future. As the threat grows, he assembles an unlikely team and confronts danger while searching for purpose, family, and a way to do the right thing.

title: Ratatouille
plot: A gifted rat dreams of becoming a chef and finds an unlikely partner in a young kitchen worker at a Paris restaurant. Together, they pursue culinary ambitions while facing suspicion from the kitchen staff, pressure from the rat’s colony, and the judgment of an influential food critic.

title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
plot: During wartime, four siblings are sent to the countryside, where a wardrobe leads them into Narnia, a magical land trapped in endless winter. With help from a noble lion and an array of talking creatures, they become part of a struggle to free the kingdom from an icy ruler.

title: Cars 3
plot: A legendary racer struggles to keep up when a faster generation takes over the sport. With help from an ambitious young technician, guidance inspired by a former mentor, and a renewed approach to training, he fights for another chance on the track.

title: Saving Private Ryan
plot: During the Normandy invasion, a captain and his small team are ordered to cross enemy-held territory and find a missing paratrooper. With the mission placing them in constant danger, the soldiers must confront fear, loyalty, sacrifice, and the devastating human cost of war.

title: Toy Story 2
plot: When a beloved cowboy toy is taken by a collector, his friends launch a daring rescue mission. Meanwhile, he meets new toys who challenge his ideas about friendship, purpose, and what it means to be loved as children grow up.

title: Alpha
plot: A highly trained assassin, raised in isolation as a super-soldier by a rogue commander, uncovers disturbing truths about her family and stolen childhood. She joins forces with a long-lost sister to challenge her creator and dismantle an illicit military program.

title: Lenin
plot: In a village shaped by generations of bloodshed, a determined young man challenges the traditions that keep an endless cycle of violence alive. His struggle tests whether one person can push back against deeply rooted customs and imagine a different future for his community.

title: Here the Whole Time
plot: An insecure teenager’s quiet vacation is disrupted when his neighbor and school crush arrives to spend two weeks at his house. What begins as a plan for peaceful days and long series marathons becomes an emotional whirlwind, bringing feelings and unresolved issues to the surface.

title: Voicemails for Isabelle
plot: A young woman leaves hilariously confessional voicemails for her late sister, but the messages are unknowingly redirected to a stranger. As the stranger listens from afar, an unexpected connection begins to grow through her candid, intimate recordings.

title: Weapons
plot: When nearly every child in one classroom vanishes from home at the same time overnight, a small community is plunged into fear and suspicion. A teacher, a grieving parent, a police officer, and the lone child left behind become connected as they search for answers amid unsettling events.

title: Road House
plot: A former mixed martial arts fighter accepts a job as a bouncer at a roadhouse in a tropical island community. What initially seems like a chance to start over soon draws him into escalating trouble involving criminals, local power struggles, and a steady stream of dangerous challengers.

title: Doctor Strange
plot: After a career-ending accident leaves a brilliant surgeon desperate for answers, he travels to a mysterious sanctuary and discovers a hidden world of magic. Under a demanding mentor, he must overcome his arrogance and learn to use unfamiliar powers against forces threatening reality.

title: It
plot: In a small Maine town, seven children face school bullies, personal fears, and a terrifying monster that often appears as a clown. As disturbing events bring them together, the group must find courage and rely on their friendship while confronting the evil threatening local children.

title: No Country for Old Men
plot: After discovering the aftermath of a drug deal in the Texas desert, a hunter takes a case of cash and becomes the target of a relentless killer. A weary sheriff follows the trail as the pursuit grows increasingly tense, violent, and unpredictable.

title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
plot: After a frightening encounter outside school, a young wizard faces punishment while authorities deny that a powerful evil has returned. Back at Hogwarts, a strict new teacher imposes control, prompting him and his classmates to secretly practice defensive magic and prepare for the dangers ahead.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog 3
plot: A speedy blue hero reunites with two close allies when a mysterious, exceptionally powerful adversary threatens the planet. Outmatched by this new foe, the trio must set aside their differences and seek an unlikely alliance before the danger grows beyond their control.

title: Grown Ups
plot: After their beloved high school basketball coach dies, five longtime friends reunite with their families for a Fourth of July holiday weekend. As they spend time together, old friendships, family dynamics, and different paths in adulthood shape a relaxed gathering filled with jokes and casual misadventures.

title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
plot: A celebrated archaeologist is recruited by the government to find the legendary Ark of the Covenant before the Nazi regime can claim it. His mission leads through dangerous sites, rival expeditions, and relentless pursuit in a globe-trotting adventure filled with action, mystery, humor, and ancient secrets.

title: Malena
plot: In a small Sicilian town during World War II, a 12-year-old boy becomes fascinated by a beautiful, lonely woman whose absent husband leaves her vulnerable to gossip and judgment. Through his innocent perspective, the story explores first love, growing up, beauty, and the cruelty of a watchful community.

title: Passenger
plot: A young couple begins a van-life adventure, but their plans unravel after they witness a gruesome highway accident. As a sinister presence follows them into the night, they must confront mounting fear, isolation, and tensions within their relationship while searching for a way to survive.

title: Culpa Nuestra
plot: At a wedding, two former lovers unexpectedly reunite after a painful breakup. He is set to inherit a family business while she begins her career, and both try to resist their lingering attraction as resentment, jealousy, and unfinished feelings draw them back together.

title: Elize: Shadows of a Woman
plot: A former escort discovers that her wealthy husband has been unfaithful, sending their marriage into a painful struggle with betrayal, distrust, and emotional turmoil. Inspired by a real case, the film explores how infidelity can reshape a relationship and the people caught within it.

title: Marty Supreme
plot: A young table tennis player dreams of becoming a champion, but few people take his ambition seriously. As he pursues recognition and funding across an increasingly chaotic journey, his relentless drive pushes him toward questionable choices and tests the cost of putting greatness above everything else.

title: Free Guy
plot: A cheerful bank teller discovers that his everyday life unfolds inside an open-world video game. With help from someone connected to the real world, he begins breaking from his routine, embracing unexpected possibilities, and trying to protect the digital world he calls home.

title: The Suicide Squad
plot: A group of imprisoned supervillains is forced into a secret government mission on a remote island controlled by hostile forces. Led by hardened specialists and joined by an unpredictable team of misfits, they must infiltrate a dangerous facility while facing overwhelming odds and their own volatile personalities.

title: Jumanji: The Next Level
plot: A group of friends returns to the dangerous game world to rescue someone who has gone missing. With the rules changed, unexpected players involved, unfamiliar environments, and new challenges ahead, they must work together and adapt quickly to find a way out.

title: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish
plot: A legendary adventurer learns that reckless exploits have left him with only one life. He sets out on a dangerous journey to find a mythical wish and restore what he has lost, while confronting fear, forming unexpected friendships, and discovering what truly matters.

title: Scream 7
plot: When a new Ghostface killer targets a quiet town, a battle-hardened mother must protect her teenage daughter from a deadly threat tied to her own troubled past. As the attacks escalate, the family is forced to confront familiar horrors while trying to uncover who can be trusted.

title: Final Destination: Bloodlines
plot: Haunted by a recurring nightmare about a past disaster, a college student returns home seeking answers from an older family member who may know how to break the cycle. As strange accidents begin threatening her relatives, she races to uncover the connection before fate catches up with them.

title: The Beekeeper
plot: After a vulnerable woman is targeted by an online scam, a quiet beekeeper launches a relentless campaign against those responsible. His pursuit soon expands beyond personal revenge, drawing in law enforcement and exposing connections to powerful institutions.

title: The Imitation Game
plot: During World War II, a brilliant but isolated mathematician joins a secret team racing to break Germany’s seemingly unbreakable code. As pressure mounts, their work could change the course of the war, while the mathematician faces deep personal and social challenges in a country that does not accept him.

title: Logan
plot: In the near future, a weary mutant cares for an ailing mentor while hiding on the Mexican border. Their fragile routine is disrupted when a young mutant arrives, pursued by dangerous forces, forcing them into a violent journey that challenges their isolation and offers a chance at protection and hope.

title: Django Unchained
plot: A newly freed man joins forces with a skilled bounty hunter and learns the trade while searching for his wife, who is held at a brutal Mississippi plantation. Their journey blends rescue, revenge, tense encounters, dark humor, and explosive action across the American South.
